Three things, done properly

We would rather run three services well than eleven services thinly, so this is the whole list and it has not changed in nine years.

The night shelter

Forty beds on Dock Street, open from seven in the evening until nine the next morning, every night of the year including Christmas. No referral is needed to get a bed.

The daytime centre

Showers, laundry, a hot lunch and somewhere warm to sit between nine and four, with a nurse on Tuesdays and a housing solicitor on the first Thursday of the month.

The tenancy team

Getting a tenancy is the easy half. Keeping it is the hard half, so our team stays with someone for a full year after they get their keys.

Harbour Light Trust, 14 Dock Street, Dundee DD1 3DR.
